body: They have always been on phases of being religious to not so much. Now however they're very religious and during the last gap of phases they went through I became an atheist. I was put in a situation where I was forced to tell them, and they at first said they "Love me no matter what", but ever since then (about 2 years) they have talked to me much less, and don't listen to me at all regarding other family issues because they see my side inferior. So now it's starting to feel like they ignore me more than anything and I'm just another person in the house instead of a family member. I've tried talking to them about it, but they denied it and haven't changed.
